stop_condition: Complete geometry validation, exterior-only shadow assessment, color-aware highlight assessment, combined original-guard verification and published comparison page. No intermediate handoff pause. Primary performs own verification.

stages.name: geometry
stages.recipe: Fixed ellipse-core parallel body from93; same actual spline/Hermite laws, current optics and material, only member major length differs.

stages.name: shadow
stages.scope: Exterior clear contribution only, fixed shared softness/offset, three fixed strengths. No optical shadow.

stages.name: highlight
stages.scope: Shared bounded color-aware edge lift with controlled desaturation; same angular fade and separate completed-body overlay.

stages.name: verification_publication
stages.scope: Own identities, metrics, native/full comparisons, original guards and side-by-side/wipe page. Preserve every rejection.

selection: Geometry or material changes that fail original paired guards stay experimental. Continue later independent stages on a supported declared baseline; no failure silently cancels the remainder of the plan. Combined candidates compared to both component baseline and original working20; no mask/foreground changes.
original_masks: Retain 16 expanded and22 compact partial pixels per reference; all original body/held/exterior/foreground guards. New coverage is supplementary, not replacement.
